name: Worship Service
overview: Worship service, as revealed in Scripture, centers on gathering in Jesus' name where He promises His presence among believers, emphasizing the communal nature of worship (Matthew 18:20). True worship honors God alone and is expressed both in spirit and truth, reflecting a sincere and heartfelt devotion (Luke 4:8; John 4:23). Additionally, worship involves presenting ourselves as living sacrifices—holy and acceptable to God—which is described as our reasonable service (Romans 12:1), and continually offering praise and thanksgiving through the fruit of our lips (Hebrews 13:15). Together, these verses highlight worship as a holistic offering of our lives and hearts to God in unity and truth.
